answer.book: Christiani Vrstisii, Elementa arithmeticae logicis legibus explicata (Basel, Petri, 1596): one arithmetic textbook in two parts, Pars I on simple arithmetic and Pars II on comparata and proportions, with numbered chapters, a dedication and a list of authors before the text, and an appendix on squares and cubes.
